sos.team_banner_body: The SOS broadcast went out automatically to {{count}} professional(s) within {{radius}} km with Professional Relevance ≥ {{pct}}%. Do not select candidates manually: the first professional who accepts takes the job. The position is not filled until someone accepts.
sos.team_banner_no_targets: No professional currently meets the SOS criteria ({{radius}} km, ≥ {{pct}}%, available today). PITCALL keeps the SOS open; new eligible professionals are contacted when the matching engine finds them.
sos.team_manual_locked: Manual Request Confirmation is disabled while the SOS is open (enforced server-side).
sos.intro: A team needs an immediate replacement on-site. You were contacted because you are within {{radius}} km, available today and above {{pct}}% Professional Relevance.
sos.first_wins: FIRST CONFIRMS = FIRST MATCH. Another professional may take this position while you decide.
sos.accept_confirm: Accept this SOS Call? If you are first, the match is confirmed immediately, your contacts are shared with the team and the days are locked on your calendar.
sos.accepted_toast: SOS accepted — match confirmed. Contacts unlocked.
sos.taken_body: Another professional accepted first. This SOS position is no longer available.
sos.won_body: You took this SOS Call. The match is confirmed and the team has your contacts.
sos.resolved_body: This SOS Call has been closed without a replacement.
sos.not_eligible: This SOS Call is not available to you.
